ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
ocaml_compiler:
- ocaml
ocaml_compiler_version:
- 5.5.1
target_platform:
- linux-64
name: ocaml-ppxlib
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: ppxlib
  version: "0.39.0"
  build_number: 1

  # ocaml_win-64 ships gcc_* and vs2022_* at the same version/build; name the track.
  c_toolchain: ${{ "" if unix else c_compiler ~ "_*" }}
  library: ${{ "Library/" if not unix else "" }}
  m2: ${{ "m2-" if not unix else "" }}
  # static archive paired with the .cmxa: msvc ships .lib, gcc and unix ship .a
  native_lib_ext: ${{ ".lib" if c_compiler == "vs2022" else ".a" }}

package:
  name: ocaml-${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/ocaml-ppx/ppxlib/releases/download/${{ version }}/ppxlib-${{ version }}.tbz
  sha256: 441a2814dbac3f5dc0c8dcefca263548e9b4d6dda1ef2990ce6a4999e108be3c

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  string: ${{ c_compiler ~ "_" if not unix }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
  script: bash ${{ RECIPE_DIR }}/build.sh ppxlib

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("ocaml") }}
    - if: not unix and c_compiler == "gcc"
      then:
        - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
      else:
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    # ocaml_win-64 >=14 only run-constrains the C compiler; activate it here, once (vs2022, zig)
    - if: not unix and c_compiler != "gcc"
      then:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    # compiler("ocaml") renders no toolchain track; name it on windows
    - if: not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
    # the cross compiler does not pull the native one; the build runs OCaml on the build machine
    - if: build_platform != target_platform and unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ build_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
        # the cross compiler activates itself (shims, OCAMLLIB, host OCAMLPATH)
        - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
    # windows cross: the self-contained gcc track needs no vcvars
    - if: build_platform != target_platform and not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ build_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* gcc_*
    - ocaml-dune >=3.4
    - ${{ m2 }}make
    - if: not unix
      then:
        - m2-bash
        - m2-coreutils
  host:
    # library: ocaml's run_export pins the compiler patch version
    - ocaml ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
    # the noarch ocaml metapackage does not pin the windows toolchain track
    - if: not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
    - ocaml-compiler-libs >=0.11
    - ocaml-dune >=3.4
    - ocaml-ppx-derivers >=1.0
    - ocaml-sexplib0 >=0.12
    - ocaml-stdlib-shims
  run:
    - ocaml-compiler-libs >=0.11
    - ocaml-ppx-derivers >=1.0
    - ocaml-sexplib0 >=0.12
    - ocaml-stdlib-shims
  # the ocaml run_export does not encode the windows toolchain track
  run_constraints:
    - if: not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
    # installed dune-package declares (lang dune X.Y); older dune cannot read it
    - ${{ pin_compatible('ocaml-dune', lower_bound='x.x', upper_bound=None) }}

tests:
  - package_contents:
      files:
        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/${{ name }}/META
        # win-arm64 is bytecode-only upstream: OCaml 5.4 has no arm64 Windows backend
        - if: target_platform != "win-arm64"
          then:
            - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/${{ name }}/ppxlib.cmxa
            - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/${{ name }}/ppxlib${{ native_lib_ext }}
            - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/${{ name }}/ast/ppxlib_ast.cmxa
            - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/${{ name }}/astlib/astlib.cmxa
  # the script links native executables, so it cannot run on the bytecode-only lane
  - if: target_platform != "win-arm64"
    then:
      script: bash testing/test_ppxlib.sh
      files:
        recipe:
          - testing/test_ppxlib.sh
      requirements:
        run:
          - ocaml ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
          - if: not unix
            then:
              - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
          - ocaml-dune >=3.4
          - if: not unix and c_compiler != "gcc"
            then:
              - ${{ compiler("c") }}
          - if: not unix
            then:
              - m2-bash
              - m2-coreutils

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/ocaml-ppx/ppxlib
  repository: https://github.com/ocaml-ppx/ppxlib
  documentation: https://ocaml-ppx.github.io/ppxlib/
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.md
  summary: Standard infrastructure for ppx rewriters

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MementoRC
    - ManuelLerchner
